item.text:
**5B.8, 2024: mostly no**
Putin made some targeted family, child, and local-finance adjustments, but the broader pattern was not fair distribution across regions or groups. The clearest 2024 pattern was war-focused spending, elite privilege, and weak regional/local autonomy.

| Stance | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | Putin signs order making equal support for families with three or more children available nationwide | Government of Russia | 2024-01-25 | https://government.ru/en/news/50700/ | A nationwide family-support measure that reduced regional variation for a concrete social benefit. This is real distributional support, but narrow and not evidence of broad fairness across classes or groups. | 5B.8 |
| Support | From 2024, parents and guardians caring for disabled children could keep the monthly allowance even if they worked part-time | Government of Russia | 2024-02-08 | https://government.ru/news/50822/ | Extends support to a vulnerable group while allowing part-time work, which is a real if limited equity-oriented adjustment. | 5B.8 |
| Support | Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024 | Notes a June 2024 directive to improve municipal finances by changing tax-revenue allocation methods. This is a small pro-region redistribution signal, though the same report says local autonomy remained weak. | 5B.8, 5B.6 |
| Support | Social Fund of Russia reports full-scale service coverage in occupied/new regions | Social Fund of Russia | 2024-12-18 | https://sfr.gov.ru/en/press_center/~2024/12/18/276536 | Shows child benefits, pregnancy payments, disability support, and health-worker payments extended to occupied/new regions. This is administrative distribution to a specific population, but it sits inside a war/occupation framework. | 5B.8 |
| Support | Children evacuated from Kursk region stay at a temporary accommodation centre in Moscow region | Reuters Connect | 2024-08-30 | https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/children-evacuated-from-kursk-region-stay-at-a-temporary-accommodation-centre-in-moscow-region/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjQ6bmV3c21sX1JDMjlROUFLNjQwVA | Concrete protective relocation for displaced children from a border region. It shows state capacity to protect a vulnerable group, but only as emergency wartime shelter. | 5B.8 |
| Against | Russian economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war, sanctions | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756 | Reuters said much of the growth and low unemployment came from military production. That suggests gains were concentrated in war-linked sectors rather than shared fairly across the population. | 5B.8, 5B.6 |
| Against | Analysis: Russia braces for more tax rises to fund the Ukraine war | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-31 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisrussia-braces-for-more-tax-rises-to-fund-the-ukraine-war-3693480 | Economists expected more tax rises to finance ballooning military spending, which points to extraction from society for war rather than broad, fair distribution of gains. | 5B.8, 5B.6 |
| Against | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Says corruption is pervasive, assets and contracts are distributed to allies in return for loyalty, and expropriation risk is elevated. That is strong evidence against fair distribution and toward supporter privilege. | 5B.8, 5B.5 |
| Against | Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Reduced disclosure for major firms weakens scrutiny of privileged actors and makes it easier for insider gains to stay hidden. | 5B.8, 5B.5 |
| Against | Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024 | Says political centralization increased, local bodies lacked real financial independence, and regional autonomy eroded. That cuts against equitable regional distribution. | 5B.8, 5B.6 |

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Putin systematically redistributed gains upward avoidance across classes, genders, and regions in a broad, rule-based way. The pro evidence is mostly targeted welfare or emergency support; the stronger evidence points to wartime extraction, elite patronage, and weak regional autonomy.
